hero_description: Long-lasting ceramic protection designed to preserve your vehicle's finish, make maintenance easier and enhance depth and gloss.
intro_paragraph_1: A ceramic coating bonds to the vehicle's surface, creating a durable protective layer over the paintwork.
intro_paragraph_2: As well as adding gloss, the hydrophobic finish helps repel water and contamination, making the vehicle easier to maintain between washes.

prices.label: Easier maintenance Hydrophobic behaviour helps water and contamination release more easily from the surface. 02 Paint protection Adds a protective layer against environmental contamination and chemical exposure. 03 Greater gloss Enhances depth and reflection for a smoother, more refined-looking finish. 04 Longer lasting Offers considerably longer-lasting protection than a conventional wax or sealant.
